question_variants: How much revenue did we make each month?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(oi.created_at, MONTH) AS month, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 36
report: Monthly revenue trend showing total sales by month, excluding cancelled and returned orders.
